label: late original-phase input of x/u/n/1/h/q/v/f, gated by the first token (t, c, j, k, ...)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at positions 3-8, never at t<3, on <DEL>, or during copy. Rate rises with position (orig_idx 8 is 8.8x) and the unit is most active near the end of the input (to_go 0 carries 41% of the mass). It depends on the current input token: x (27% of mass), u, n, 1 and h, then q, v, f; most other tokens almost never fire it. It is much stronger when the sequence starts with t (4.6x lift; nearly all top examples begin with t), and also when it starts with c, j, k, e, w, o or z. First occurrences of the token dominate (89% of mass). Magnitude is highest for x late in sequences that start with t. The conjunction reaches dev F1 0.48 / mass recall 0.66, so the unit behaves like a graded additive mix of current-token and first-token contributions rather than a clean rule.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=6: x, u, 1, n; t=7: x, u, n, h; t=5: x, u, n, 1) and the first original token (most: t, c, j, k, e, w; least: x, 1, h, f); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=8, t=5, t=4.
